test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

He was __beaming from ear to ear__.
solution:
The correct answer is **Smiling broadly.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom is **Smiling broadly.**
 
• Beaming from ear to ear means** having a broad, enthusiastic smile.**
 
• Thus the correct answer is** **Smiling broadly.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Similar to this idioms - grin from ear to ear, grin, be grinning from ear to ear, have (one's) ear, have somebody's ear, have someone's ear, have the ear of (one).
 
• **Examples **- ***I like your graduation photo, with you grinning from ear to ear and your parents looking so proud.***
 
 
• ***​When they turned into Rue Lhomond, the girl was waiting for them, beaming from ear to ear.***
